Country.evidence_source: In Ghana, where social expectations pressure men to provide for their families, internalizing such views of the self may amplify feelings of failure, inadequacy, and distress.

Area.evidence_source: Some of our informants had lost faith, either in themselves or in God, which led to the suicide attempt. It is noteworthy that only men raised such existential struggles as among the reasons for their suicide attempts. Loss of faith in themselves describes a general feeling of inadequacy or sense of failure in life as a central reason for the suicide attempt.
